Reply in English with a short greeting.

Houston,

I am writing to you in English with a short greeting. I hope this message finds you well and that your journey through the United States is as smooth as possible.

As for my language proficiency, I have been studying Spanish since I was a child, and it has always fascinated me. I believe that learning another language can greatly enhance your understanding of the world around you.

I am here to assist you in any way I can, whether through translation or simply sharing stories about your journey across the United States. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to ask.

Reply in English: What is the capital of Brazil?
The capital of Brazil is Brasília.

hits.title: Brasília - Wikipedia
hits.snippet: Brasília (/ brəˈzɪliə / brə-ZIL-ee-ə; [3][4] Brazilian Portuguese: [bɾaˈziliɐ, bɾaˈziljɐ] ⓘ) is the capital city of Brazil and the Federal District. Located in the Brazilian Highlands in the country's Central-West region, it was founded by President Juscelino Kubitschek on 21 April 1960, to replace Rio de Janeiro as the national capital . hits.title: Capitals of Brazil - Wikipedia
hits.snippet: Capitals of Brazil The current capital of Brazil , since its construction in 1960, is Brasília. Rio de Janeiro was the country's capital between 1763 and 1960. The city of Salvador served as the seat for the Portuguese colonial administration in Brazil for its first two centuries and is usually called the "first capital of Brazil ." [1]

hits.title: What is the Capital of Brazil? - Mappr
hits.snippet: The capital of Brazil is Brasília, located in the state of Goias. It became the country's capital city in 1960, after four years of planning and construction.

hits.title: Brasília - Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
hits.snippet: Brasília (bɾaˈziliɐ) is the capital city of Brazil . The name is commonly spelled Brasilia in English . The city and its Federal District are in the Central-West region of the country. It is on a plateau known as Planalto Central. Brasília has a population of about 2,557,000 (3,599,000 in the metropolitan area) as of the 2008 IBGE estimate.
